heading: Reactor configuration
reported_value: pin (anode, 9 mm, 2 mm tip) to ring (cathode, 22 mm ID) DC discharge in a 38 mm glass tube; water-cooled Cu electrodes; 22-nozzle injector 120 mm above; ZrO2 packed bed (3 mm balls) in the ring; axial magnetic field 30 mT (NdFeB) or Helmholtz coils to 15 mT
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The plasma forms between the two actively cooled copper electrodes ... A packed bed of zirconium dioxide balls of dmean = 3 mm diameter can be utilized to improve gas flow

heading: Electricity supply
reported_value: DC lab power supply -> ZVS oscillator -> ferrite step-up transformer -> HV rectifier (5 nF) -> choke 1.5-3.0 H; input 0-360 W; no stable discharge below 152 W supply
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The driver consists of a ZVS (zero voltage switching) alternator, ferrite core step up transformer and a high voltage rectifier ... Input power can be varied between 0 <= Psupp <= 360 W, while no stable discharge can be generated below Psupp < 152 W

heading: Electricity supply
reported_value: P_plasma = I_plasma x V_plasma (HV probes, shunt, average current); P_supply from DC voltage and current of the lab power supply; Helmholtz coil power (up to 200 W) excluded
evidence_excerpt_or_description: Power supplied to the system is calculated from the DC voltage Vsupply and current Isupply of the power supply ... This power input is not considered in efficiency calculations, because the coils are only used instead of permanent magnets
basis_and_boundary: plasma (reactor terminals) and DC input to the driver
notes: mains-to-DC losses of the lab supply excluded: 'system' is not wall plug; main measurements used permanent magnets

heading: Electricity supply
reported_value: 61-65% in all operation points; limits system efficiency to max 29%
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The driver circuit operated at efficiencies between 61 < eta_sup < 65% in all operation points. The optimization of the supply was outside of the scope of this study and limits the overall energy efficiency to a maximum of eta_sys,max = 29%
notes: lab driver including a 3 H choke; Fig. 4 point at 218 W implies 0.56 (C002) BB 2026-11-25: agrees that Fig. 4 at ~216 W (system 25%, plasma ~46%) implies a driver efficiency of ~54%, below the stated 61-65%; possibly the stated range refers to particular operating points, or something was omitted in the system/supply efficiency calculation. Not resolved; text values kept.

heading: Performance indicators
reported_value: NDIR CO and CO2 (SmartGas Flow Evo); GC (Trace 1310) for O2, CO2, CO and traces at the best points; X = c_CO/(c_CO + c_CO2); steady state after >=1 min and >=2 residence times
evidence_excerpt_or_description: This formula is valid under the assumption that the reaction occurs stoichiometrically and with 100% yield ... Exhaust gas was measured after at least one minute of operation
notes: GC confirmed stoichiometric O2 and CO and no trace gases (p. 3)

heading: Operating conditions
reported_value: 0.65, 0.75, 1.0, 1.25 SLM; needle valve with analogue flow meter calibrated by displacement cylinder to standard conditions
evidence_excerpt_or_description: Experiments were performed at multiple gas flow rates of V = [0.65; 0.75; 1.0; 1.25] SLM

heading: Operating conditions
reported_value: NdFeB magnets 30 mT, ZrO2 packed bed, choke 3 H unless stated
evidence_excerpt_or_description: If not stated otherwise, all measurements were conducted using the neodymium magnets, at a field of 30 mT, zirconium oxide packed bed and a choke inductance of L = 3 H

heading: Performance indicators
reported_value: eta = X dH V_in / P_el, P_el = P_plasma or P_supply; dH = 12.6 J/SCC
evidence_excerpt_or_description: where the specific enthalpy is dH = 12.6J SCC-1 and V_in is the supplied gas flow

heading: Performance indicators
reported_value: X 16-29%; at 1.25 SLM: 98 W 15%, 117 W 20%, 165 W ~26%, 192 W ~27%; 0.65 SLM up to ~28.8% at ~20 J/SCC; conversion at 192 W often lower than at 165 W
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The conversion depends strongly on the applied power, ranging between 16 < X < 29%
notes: plateau at 29% attributed to equilibrium or incomplete gas exposure

heading: Performance indicators
reported_value: 1.25 SLM: X 27.4%, eta_plasma 45%, eta_system 28%; abstract: 43% at 27%, plasma power up to 220 W
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The best operation point was measured at the maximum gas flow of V = 1.25 SLM: The reactor reached a conversion of X = 27.4% at eta_plasma = 45% energy efficiency in the plasma or eta_system = 28% for the whole system

heading: Performance indicators
evidence_excerpt_or_description: Read by eye from rendered page; text: 'Maximum energy efficiency achieved in the plasma is eta_plasma = 45% at an applied power of Psupply = 216 W'
notes: averaged GC and NDIR; text's 45% at 216 W is the 21% conversion point

heading: Performance indicators
reported_value: reference 117 W, 30 mT, 1.25 SLM: X 20%; upward flow 10.5%; no packed bed 7.5%; choke 1.5 H no effect; weaker field lower X
evidence_excerpt_or_description: With inverted gas flow (up instead of down), conversion reduced significantly from Xref = 20% to Xdown = 10.5% ... Without usage of the packed bed, the conversion decreased to Xno bed = 7.5%
notes: role of the ZrO2 bed (catalytic or flow) unknown

heading: Operating conditions
reported_value: reactor run <10 h in total; no electrode degradation observed; packed bed above 800 C at 192 W
evidence_excerpt_or_description: electrode degradation could not be observed. This is to be expected, since the reactor was only run for less than 10 h total ... at 192 W the red glow hints at temperatures of the packed bed of above 800 C

heading: Plasma characteristics
reported_value: glow-to-arc transition; ignition <20 kV; operation <2 kV, <200 V/mm; 50-275 mA; rotation period 5-40 ms; min. sustaining plasma power ~100 W
evidence_excerpt_or_description: an ignition voltage of Vignition < 20 kV sufficed. Operation voltage is significantly lower, typically less than Voperation < 2 kV
notes: authors expect multi-kW reactors from larger gap and higher voltage at constant current (p. 5)

heading: Performance indicators
evidence_excerpt_or_description: E_spec = P/(SLM x 1000/60); eta = X x 12.6 / E_spec; EC = E_spec/X; kWh/Nm3 = J/mL / 3.6

heading: Electricity supply
evidence_excerpt_or_description: P_plasma = X x 262.5 W / eta_plasma at 1.25 SLM
notes: conclusion's 27.4% / 45% / 28% point is P_supply ~262 W, P_plasma ~162 W
